snapshot_scope: isolated staged GP14 source, GP15 excluded

observations.east_bay: Nested grey pointed frames and small central medallion replace the plain recessed face; narrow muted green/yellow/cyan/brown decorative strips flank the retained outer rib and lantern.
observations.paving: Grey and ochre outer floor is more distinct; the full-circumference central altar tiers, ward/core and entry paving stay visually identical.
observations.open_cutaway: Muted narrow color accents and nested stone profiles remain secondary to the central stepped altar. The surrounding clear walk and existing outer shell silhouette remain stable.

limits: Offline geometry with slabs modeled as half blocks; lanterns and other blocks use diagnostic cubes and approximate colors. No native textures, lighting, NPC pathfinding or exact TLC reconstruction claim. Cropped/removed geometry is enumerated in chamber-render-scope.json.
